entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikołaj (Nicholas) Dzierzgowski (1490–1559) was Archbishop of Gniezno and Primate of Poland. He was born in 1490 into a szlachta family of the Jastrzębiec coat of arms. He was born out of wedlock to Jeżewskiego de Dzierzgów and either Zbigniewy Wilkanowskiej or Catherine Wilkanowskiej.
